scope_note: Requirement scope baseline, not an implementation or completion snapshot. Every V7 slice and all 17 V6 work-breakdown items are included; V5 includes its mobile packages, pillars, foundations, gaps and acceptance. Optional work is explicit. Linked issue state is not proof of merged code, installed-app verification, device acceptance or release. Unmapped requirements remain visible and need evidence reconciliation; metadata is not a permission grant or automatic execution order. See docs/workflow/VERSION_MAPPING_2026-10-30.md.
